title: Is virtual planning using standardized temporomandibular joint prostheses appropriate? Case series
html: The evolution of virtual surgical planning of advanced corrections of the temporomandibular joint with a total joint replacement (TJR), and with simultaneous corrections of dentofacial deformities, has contributed to a profound improvement of treatment possibilities. However, in cases where virtual surgical planning has been desirable, a customized TJR has up to now been preferred. As such, a customized patient-specific implant always comes with a higher cost compared to a standardized total joint replacement design.
